{{Short description|Australian statistician}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2026}}
'''John Sydney Croucher''' {{post-nominals|country=AUS|AM}} is an Australian statistician and Professor of Actuarial Studies and Business Analytics in the Macquarie Business School at [[Macquarie University]] in Sydney Australia.  He has written around 33 books, 120 research papers, and 500 newspaper articles.

His recent works include ''[https://www.woodslane.com.au/Book/9781922131614/Kid-from-Norfolk-Island The Kid from Norfolk Island]'' ([https://www.woodslane.com.au/ Woodslane], 2014), ''[https://www.amberley-books.com/mistress-of-science-9916.html Mistress of Science]'' ([https://www.amberley-books.com/ Amberley], 2018), ''[https://www.amberley-books.com/women-of-science.html Women of Science]'' ([https://www.amberley-books.com/ Amberley], 2019) and ''A Concise History of New South Wales'' ([https://www.woodslane.com.au/ Woodslane], 2020). Croucher has written many textbooks on mathematics and statistics for [https://www.mheducation.com.au/ McGraw-Hill Australia], including ''[https://www.mheducation.com.au/quantitative-analysis-for-management-6e-9781760425029-aus Quantitative Analysis for Management 6e]'' (2020), [https://www.mheducation.com.au/introductory-mathematics-and-statistics-6th-edition-revised-9781743766149-aus-group ''Mathematics and Statistics for Business 6e'' (revised)] (2016) and ''[https://www.mheducation.com.au/statistics-making-business-decisions-9780074710418-aus Statistics: Making Business Decisions]'' (2001),

Croucher has also written many trade books, including ''Love by [https://www.woodslane.com.au/Book/9781921683602/Love-by-Numbers Numbers]'' ([https://www.woodslane.com.au/ Woodslane], 2011), ''[https://www.harpercollins.com.au/9780730445333/the-secret-language/ The Secret Language]'' ([[ABC Books (imprint)|ABC Books]], 2010). ''[https://books.google.com/books?id=Yy9ozzpA2ioC Number Crunch]'' ( [[Pan Macmillan]], 2006), ''[https://www.woodslane.com.au/Book/9781921606113/Eighteen-Months-on-the-Toilet-and-other-Feats-Facts-Astonishing-Stats Eighteen Months on the Toilet]'' ([https://www.woodslane.com.au/ Woodslane], 2010 ), ''[https://www.woodslane.com.au/Book/9781921606182/637-Gorillas-on-the-Run-and-other-Feats-Facts-and-Astonishing-Stats 637 Gorillas on the Run]'' ([https://www.woodslane.com.au/ Woodslane], 2010), ''[https://www.amazon.com.au/Exam-Scams-Cheating-Stories-Excuses/dp/186448165X Exam Scams]'' ([[Allen & Unwin|Allen and Unwin]], 1996) and ''[https://www.amazon.com/Great-Frauds-Everyday-Scams-Adventurers/dp/1864484519 Great Frauds and Everyday Scams]'' ([[Allen & Unwin|Allen and Unwin]], 1997)

Croucher has PhD degrees in history from both [[Macquarie University]] and the [[University of Technology Sydney]]. He also holds a PhD in Mathematics and Statistics from the [[University of Minnesota]] in the United States. Croucher also has an [[honorary doctorate]] from [[Divine Word University]] in [[Papua New Guinea]].<ref>{{cite web|title=About Professor John Croucher AM|url=https://www.mgsm.edu.au/about-us/our-staff/mgsm-faculty/mgsm-faculty/johncroucher|publisher=[[Macquarie Graduate School of Management]]|accessdate=20 June 2017}}</ref> and was the recipient of the Prime Minister's Australian University Teacher of the Year award in 2013.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Macquarie Matters – Professor John Croucher in a class of his own|date=27 February 2014 |url=https://www.mq.edu.au/macquariematters/john-croucher-received-the-prime-ministers-award-for-university-teacher-of-the-year-in-november-2013/|access-date=16 August 2020}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Counihan|first=Bella|title=Number cruncher named university teacher of the year|url=http://theconversation.com/number-cruncher-named-university-teacher-of-the-year-20502|access-date=16 August 2020|website=The Conversation|date=20 November 2013 |language=en}}</ref> He is also a renowned speaker<ref>{{Cite web|title=John Croucher|url=https://www.saxton.com.au/speakers/john-croucher|access-date=16 August 2020|website=Saxton Speakers|language=en-AU}}</ref> and the subject of many articles.<ref>{{Cite web|title=John S Croucher|url=https://www.sciencefocus.com/author/johnscroucher/|access-date=16 August 2020|website=BBC Science Focus Magazine|language=en}}</ref> Between 200 and 2012 he was the author of the popular ''Number Crunch'' column for the Good Weekend<ref>{{Cite web|title=Good Weekend|url=https://www.smh.com.au/topic/good-weekend-1qq|access-date=16 August 2020|website=The Sydney Morning Herald|language=en}}</ref> in the [[The Sydney Morning Herald|Sydney Morning Herald]] and [[The Age]] in Melbourne.

He is married to fellow academic [[Rosalind Croucher]] and they both became [[Member of the Order of Australia|Members of the Order of Australia]] as part of the [[2015 Australia Day Honours]].<ref>{{cite news|last1=Theodosiou|first1=Peter|title=Thornleigh professors appointed Members (AM) of the Order of Australia|url=http://www.dailytelegraph.com.au/newslocal/the-hills/thornleigh-professors-appointed-members-am-of-the-order-of-australia/news-story/a40afc384dbc194b934d237b162f64bc|accessdate=20 June 2017|work=[[The Daily Telegraph (Sydney)|The Daily Telegraph]]|date=31 January 2015}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Desiatnik|first=Shane|date=27 January 2015|title=Husband and wife team both garner a gong|url=https://www.bluemountainsgazette.com.au/story/2838651/husband-and-wife-team-both-garner-a-gong/|access-date=16 August 2020|website=Blue Mountains Gazette|language=en}}</ref> John Croucher is also a Fellow of the [[Royal Society of the Arts]] and a Fellow of the [[Australian Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Fellows of the Australian Mathematical Society – Australian Mathematical Society|url=https://austms.org.au/membership/fellows-of-the-australian-mathematical-society/|access-date=16 August 2020|language=en-US}}</ref>
